**Last updated: November 15, 2026**

This website is maintained by Marcelo Maciel Amaral to share scientific research, publications, open-source projects, and professional activities.

## Information Collection

You can browse this website without creating an account or providing personal information. These static pages have no contact forms or account registration.

The website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub logs visitors' IP addresses for security and may process other technical access information for hosting and operational purposes, in accordance with its [Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## Cookies and Third-Party Services

The site has no visitor analytics service or advertising pixels of its own.

Some pages load fonts from Google Fonts, equation-rendering resources from jsDelivr and cdnjs, or an embedded YouTube video. These services receive technical request information, such as IP addresses and browser information. YouTube may use cookies or similar technologies under [Google's Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

Page features may save interface preferences locally in your browser. Your browser may also cache website resources.

Links to external services, including research repositories, academic publishers, and social media platforms, are governed by their respective privacy policies.

## Contact

If you contact me by email or another communication platform, I may retain the information you voluntarily provide to respond to your inquiry or maintain professional correspondence. I do not sell personal information collected through correspondence.

## Updates

This policy may be updated if the website's functionality or privacy practices change.

For questions, please use the [Contact](../contact/index.qmd) page.
